text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Here are the ones in the search results.

**Available to buy in the US**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** It is Qi2.2 certified with up to 25W wireless charging and a 45W USB-C port. It works with the iPhone 17 and 16 series and with Qi2.2 phones like the Pixel 10 Pro XL ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). Notebookcheck listed it at $79.99 on Amazon and $59.99 on Baseus's site at launch. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/) tested code AM52 on 2026-10-25, which brings the price from $59.99 to $53.99. [Buy via Dealectric (affiliate link to Baseus's US store)](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through that link, at no extra cost to you. Check the final price at checkout.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, an active cooling fan, 45W USB-C in and out, and a built-in stand and display. It costs $109.99 and is a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. Anker lists it for iPhone 17/16/15/14/13 series only (not the 16e). [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm US pricing or stock**

- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank:** In July 2025 it was announced as the first Qi2.2-certified power bank with 25W wireless charging. It was planned for sale on UGREEN's site and Amazon US. I have no current buy link or price, so search for it on those stores. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank (10,000 mAh):** ESR describes it as the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank at 13.8 mm, previewed at CES 2026. The release says it's available on Amazon and ESR's site, but I have no price or direct link. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

**Not for US buyers**

- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** It is a 10,000 mAh Qi2.2 25W bank, but it was released in Japan (¥8,980) and sold through Japanese stores. [Press release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)

**Things to know**
- Full 25W needs a Qi2.2-capable phone, such as the iPhone 16/17 series. Older MagSafe iPhones will charge more slowly.
- Use a MagSafe-compatible case, as Anker notes.

For the best value, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 is the cheapest confirmed option. The Anker MagGo 2 Pro costs more but adds active cooling. I can compare either one against the UGREEN or ESR models if you'd like.
